title: How much does AI cost to build? | AI Basics
description: Building an AI can cost as much as building a skyscraper, hundreds of millions of dollars. Almost all of it goes into one step: training. Nobody programs the AI, it learns by itself, like showing it the whole internet and letting it play until it gets good. Part 3 of AI Basics: the hardware. #aibasics #aitraining #ai #aiexplained #shorts
